next.reason: 1985: "When the REVERSED phrase is specified, the subsequent READ statements for the file make the data records of the file available in reversed order"; 2023: "No REVERSED phrase; GR 20 lists only "open mode specification, the sharing-phrase, retry-phrase, and REWIND phrase"". The 2023 OPEN rules cover NO REWIND, SHARING and RETRY but never REVERSED; positioning rule 12 names only EXTEND and NO REWIND. The REVERSED phrase is dropped.
